svg.title: Mixing schemes by role
svg.desc: Three bills split by component. ML-DSA-44 everywhere: 15,802 bytes. ML-DSA-44 for the leaf and Falcon-512 for the CA, root and logs: 8,327. SNOVA for leaf and CA and UOV for root and logs: 3,990. The SCTs and the root signature shrink the most when the signer can use a scheme with a tiny signature.

text.tspan: SNOVA leaf + CA, UOV root + logs: 3,990 B
the 1,078 bytes of structure are now a quarter of the best bill: Part 07 goes after them too.
